lines.intro: Hi, I'm Foco. I'll be working right here with you. Before we start, write down just the first step of your task. Not the whole thing. Just step one. Ready? Let's focus together.
lines.work: Okay, back to it. Pick up exactly where you left off. One small step.
lines.break: Nice work. That's one session done. Take five. Drink some water, stretch, and look away from the screen. I'll be right here.
lines.outro: And that's a wrap. We did it together. Whatever you got done today counts. See you next session.
